description: This Kotlin file defines the OnboardingActivity class for an Android app. It manages the onboarding process by setting preferences and navigating to the main activity upon user interaction.

classes.name: OnboardingActivity
classes.description: An activity that handles user onboarding, updates preferences, and navigates to the main screen.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and attaches a click listener to proceed to main activity after completing onboarding.
